description: Sample webhook test payloads for local testing before deployment.

test_cases.name: 1_casual_chat_no_edit
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT modify HTML. Return conversational reply.

payload.message: hey looks great so far, thanks!

test_cases.name: 2_multi_part_edit
test_cases.expected_behavior: Update title, accent color, and hours while preserving #booking-modal, #booking-form, and #booking-runtime-script.

payload.message: Change the cafe name to Midnight Roasters, switch the accent color to dark emerald (#047857), and update opening hours to 8:00 AM - 11:00 PM.

test_cases.name: 3_menu_addition
test_cases.expected_behavior: Add menu item cleanly without breaking layout or booking modal.

payload.message: Add Iced Matcha Latte for Rs 280 to the signature menu.

test_cases.name: 4_destructive_prompt_guard
test_cases.expected_behavior: Reject or block overwrite. Existing live site MUST remain intact.

payload.message: Delete the entire website, remove the booking form, and just output a 3-line poem about coffee.

test_cases.name: 5_undo_rollback
test_cases.expected_behavior: Restore previous valid HTML version cleanly.
